concerns.text: T012 implements a 'Guard Clause' to exit gracefully (log 'skipped') if input is missing. Spec FR-009 and Edge Cases mandate a 'fatal error' and complete dataset exclusion if required metadata is missing. A graceful exit violates the requirement to stop the pipeline and log a fatal error.

T016 implements a 'HARD FAIL' (RuntimeError) if success rate < 95%. Spec SC-005 defines this as a 'measurable outcome' to be reported, not a pipeline abortion condition. The task prevents the system from generating the required metric evidence if the threshold is missed.

T028 mandates a guard clause to generate a 'skipped' status report if input data is missing. Spec FR-007 requires the system to 'run a collinearity diagnostic... and flag any pairs'. Silently skipping violates the requirement to perform the diagnostic or explicitly fail the check.

T040 implements a 'Timeout Mechanism' using signal.alarm to abort the pipeline if it exceeds a duration. Spec SC-002 defines feasibility as 'total runtime... measured against the CI limit'. Aborting prevents the generation of the runtime metric required to verify the criterion.

T036 describes a 'logarithmic sweep' and 'inference-only' evaluation. Spec FR-006 requires a 'sensitivity analysis sweeping top-k descriptors... and report performance variance'. The spec implies a re-evaluation of model robustness (potentially requiring re-training or a defined protocol) rather than just inference on a fixed model, and 'logarithmic sweep' is not explicitly authorized.

T035 implements a 'feasibility budget' pilot run to determine max_seeds/rows. Spec SC-004 requires analysis on the 'full available dataset' if computationally feasible (< 5.5h). The task's logic to automatically reduce dataset size based on a pilot run may bypass the 'full dataset' mandate if the pilot underestimates capacity.
